links.outcome: Fairness of cardiac arrest outcome predictions by gender and predictive performance after bias mitigation
links.effect: FairFML improved fairness by up to 65% compared to centralized models, without compromising predictive performance.
links.quote: Validated in a real-world study on gender disparities in cardiac arrest outcomes, FairFML improved fairness by up to 65% compared to centralized models, without compromising predictive performance.

unlisted_practices: Fairness-aware federated learning to train models across institutions without sharing patient data

screen.reason: Evaluates a proposed federated machine learning framework (FairFML) designed to mitigate gender disparities in cardiac arrest outcomes.
